title: Antique Bronze Shower Curtain Rod Brackets, 3-Inch Wall-Mounted Solid Brass Pair For 1-Inch Rod, Allied Brass
description: Shower curtain rod brackets for bathroom installations, sized 3 inches L x 2.25 inches H x 3 inches W (3-inch x 2.25-inch x 3-inch), with 2-inch projection — available in Antique Bronze, which combines deep brown tones with subtle warm highlights, offering heritage appeal with modern durability. These wall mount / wall-mounted shower curtain rod supports are made from solid brass (brass construction) and are manufactured for use with any 1-inch diameter shower curtain rod (1 inch, 1-inch, 1in). Sold as a pair; shower rod must be purchased separately. Includes brackets plus all installation hardware; concealed screw mounting for a clean traditional look. Product weight 1.6 lb; weight capacity 2 lb.  and backed by a limited lifetime warranty. Coordinate with matching Prestige Regal pieces for classic bath accessories, estate bath accessories, and traditional bathroom hardware. Allied Brass Prestige Regal collection.
